query:
SELECT e.id, e.nome, e.slug, e.cor, e.ativo, e.tenantId, t.nome as tenantNome, t.plano, t.ativo as tenantAtivo
FROM empresas e
LEFT JOIN tenants t ON e.tenantId = t.id
WHERE e.ativo = 1
ORDER BY t.nome, e.nome;
